comment: The statement that countries may “set aside elements” is appropriately flexible, but it could be interpreted as allowing countries to omit essential capabilities without documenting the consequences.

anchor.note: p.41 l.Lines 10-13 read as the printed page; section 3 does NOT agree

public.text: The statement that countries may “set aside elements” is appropriately flexible, but it could be interpreted as allowing countries to omit essential capabilities without documenting the consequences.
public.suggestedRevision: Add: “Where elements are omitted, combined, or substantially modified, countries should document the rationale, affected capabilities, relevant risks, and any alternative arrangements through which the intended outcomes will be achieved.”
